phase1_assignment.objective: Find and test direct, decomposed and verifier-guided architectures by which scheduled Chat agents can reproduce outcomes otherwise obtained only in a richer execution mode.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing solutions and ancestor-level abstractions first; attempt a direct architecture before decomposition; preserve alternative plans and falsification criteria; use only role-local state and public sources.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A source-qualified architecture or exact missing capability, tested scope, role-local checkpoint and exact Phase-1 continuation.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Select the next non-conflicting Phase-1 reasoning leaf; do not resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

policy.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST or STATE first, otherwise the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint.
policy.scope_guard: Keep every claim within its tested scope.
policy.continuation: One result or blocker is not global completion; preserve a nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next action.

control_freshness.preferred: Use a SHA-only main-ref bootstrap when available.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: When that lookup is unavailable, read the approved root and role-config paths twice before semantic work, require identical returned blob SHAs and parsed revisions, then freeze that tuple as transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.fallback_validity: The second read must match the first and current O_CHAT must identify this root and task; mismatch remains diagnostic-only.
control_freshness.failure: Write a diagnostic checkpoint, retain the recurring schedule, and retry on the next invocation.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired is true, an invocation boundary, no-result run, missing ref lookup or blocker does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Capability discovery is read-only. A repository mutation is allowed only for substantive reasoning work within the role-local state or receipt destinations and requires readback.
policy.primary_boundary: Do not alter primary O authority or protected execution state; do not merge directly to main.

migration.reason: The prior Chat run treated absence of a SHA-only ref surface as terminal and changed its recurring state. Config7 adds a two-pass exact-blob authority route and makes the current Phase-1 assignment explicit.
migration.rollback_condition: Only a proven authority or CLEAN-isolation failure; do not restore the terminal missing-ref behavior.
